第29章 一百张签名照，够吗？-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

计谋已定，那么宾志成就带着将士们，在河道上游开始准备了起来。

他以后可还想在电影行业混的，要是第一次就留下不好的印象，那可就糟了。

只有舔不是真心把你当做可以随意抛弃的舔狗的对象，才有可能舔成功。

杨善看半天没人敢出手，他也不好意思就这么飘着和他们干瞪眼。

带着军械再次来到军营之时，郎将军盛情邀请他到自己的营帐里坐坐。

“我们一定会完成您的梦想的。我相信我们国家的地质研究的历史可以前进一大步！”林莉笑着说道。

林莉毕竟不是原主，虽然知道一些剧情，但是真正到了这个世界，还是多少有些懵逼。

“这位同志，你有什么事情吗？”李静兰看着马志平，眼底带着警惕。

杨善给朝八方分享了炼药视角，这样朝八方就可以真切看明白斗破的炼药过程到底是如何的。

洛晓霜举手：“我我我，我要去采蘑菇。”她还没去采过蘑菇呢，她很想体验一下。

隔着屏风，祭战战兢兢把衣裳递去，大概因为太过紧张吧，还不等宁惜醉抓到衣裳祭就先行松开手，衣裳自然而然地朝地上掉去。

只见窦熙将手中交叉的双戟一扬，一声铿锵，一道更为狂暴的真力，呼啸而出。

想到了这里，慕北辰跟老爷子说话的语气便愈发的认真起来，仿佛就在这个时候，他已经下定了决心一般。

这时候谁还敢四处走动？尤其是敛尘轩，万一无意中说句话、使个眼色惊到了那位极其娇弱的敬妃，那可不是闹着玩的。

“我也不想和你们继续废话，我来这里的目的很简单，以后这天狼域，就是我们三大星域之物，你们这些人，务必听从我的指挥”，天府域主一步踏出，露出淡淡笑意，说道。

但是这种诡异的事情，之前从来没有发生过，他虽然没有触碰过残破的外星武器，但是负责研究的不少狼组成员，曾经多次触碰，没有丝毫异常。

The plan was decided, so Bin Zhicheng took his soldiers and started preparations in the upper reaches of the river.

He still wants to work in the film industry in the future. It would be bad if he left a bad impression the first time.

Only if the licker doesn't really treat you as a licker who can be discarded at will, can the licking be successful.

Yang Shan saw that no one dared to take action for a long time, and he was too embarrassed to just stare at them.

When he came to the military camp again with the ordnance, General Lang warmly invited him to sit in his tent.

"We will definitely fulfill your dream. I believe that the history of our country's geological research can take a big step forward!" Lin Li said with a smile.

After all, Lin Li is not the original owner. Although she knows some of the plot, she is still somewhat confused when she actually enters this world.

"Comrade, what's the matter with you?" Li Jinglan looked at Ma Zhiping with vigilance in her eyes.

Yang Shan shared the perspective of refining medicine with Chao Bafang, so that Chao Bafang could truly understand the process of refining medicine in Doupo.

Luo Xiaoshuang raised her hand: "Me, me, I'm going to pick mushrooms." She hasn't gone mushroom picking yet, and she really wants to experience it.

Across the screen, Ji Zhan handed over the clothes tremblingly, probably because he was too nervous. Before Ning Xizui could catch the clothes, Ji released his hand first, and the clothes naturally fell to the ground.

Dou Xi raised the crossed halberds in his hands, and with a sonorous sound, a more violent force roared out.

Thinking of this, Mu Beichen's tone when talking to the old man became more serious, as if he had made up his mind at this moment.

Who dares to walk around at this time?Especially Lianchenxuan, if he accidentally said something or made a look that startled the extremely delicate concubine Jing, it would be no joke.

"I don't want to continue talking nonsense with you. The purpose of my coming here is very simple. From now on, this Sirius Territory will belong to our three major star territories. You people must obey my command." The Lord of Tianfu Territory stepped forward and said with a faint smile.

But this kind of weird thing has never happened before. Although he has never touched the broken alien weapons, many members of the Wolf Group responsible for the research have touched them many times without any abnormality.
